title: Sentiment of a review
subtitle: Problem Set 6
blurb: Predict whether a sentence from an Amazon, IMDB or Yelp review is positive (1) or negative (0), from the data of Kotzias et al. (2015). Fit your model in your own notebook, then upload it here: a model.py defining sentiment_model(review) and the file(s) holding its fitted parameters.
rules: Fit on the training file only (2383 sentences).
Be honest. Score once on the test file (596 sentences), after you have committed to a single model, and write down the accuracy you expect before you do.
Any model you fitted yourself. No pretrained sentiment models or word lists from elsewhere.

    return {t for t in re.findall(r"\b\w+\b", sentence) if not t.isdigit()}
